title: Five help articles covered the same query as a marketing guide, and neither side linked to the other

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, two independent finders: seo-content and seo-help). content/help/find-your-people/{high-functioning-loneliness, how-to-calm-down-fast, make-friends-as-an-adult, meet-people-in-a-new-city, how-to-stop-doomscrolling}.md carry the same titles and intent as /loneliness, /calm-down-fast and /friendship-as-an-adult (next.config.ts already 308s the retired /meet-people-new-city and /life-after-the-feed guides into those three), every one self-canonical and in the sitemap, with zero links between the sides. CLOSED 2026-10-05 for the link half: each help twin opens with 'Read the full guide first' linking its guide, and its updated date moves. The choice that is left is the owner's and is SCAN-673: keep both with the guide as the ranking page, canonicalise the help twins to the guides, or retire the twins with 308s as the fifteen retired guides were.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const want={"high-functioning-loneliness":"](/loneliness)","how-to-calm-down-fast":"](/calm-down-fast)","make-friends-as-an-adult":"](/friendship-as-an-adult)","meet-people-in-a-new-city":"](/friendship-as-an-adult)","how-to-stop-doomscrolling":"](/loneliness)"};const miss=Object.entries(want).filter(([f,l])=>!fs.readFileSync("content/help/find-your-people/"+f+".md","utf8").includes(l)).map(([f])=>f);if(miss.length){console.error("SCAN-669: help twin(s) "+miss.join(", ")+" cover the same query as a marketing guide and do not link to it, so the two self-canonical pages compete for the same search intent with no signal about which is the answer.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
